text:
maria: deploy complete — inference-api v3.4.1 rolled to canary (10%) at 22:05 UTC. holding for a 10m bake. pls run quick verifications: latency p50/p95, 5xx rate, embeddings sanity, batch queue depth. rollback criteria: >2% 5xx OR p50 > 120ms sustained for 2m. ping results here. :rocket:

nikhil: on it, kicking off the smoke runner now
```
./tools/smoke.sh --env=prod --path=/v1/generate --concurrency=5 --samples=200
```

qa-bot: smoke run finished — 200 requests: 200 OK, median latency 78ms, p95 142ms, 5xx 0.0% 

josh: looking at datadog — p50 steady, small tail at p95 around 140-150ms. no error spike. dashboard: <https://datadog/redwood/dashboards/1234|latency dashboard>

sre-ops: watching infra — gpu-pool-3 CPU/GPU load spiked to ~88% for ~90s but autoscaler added node, back down to 52%. no OOMs. keeping 15m watch :eyes:

elaine: i see a handful of tokenization errors in logs just after the deploy, sample log: 
```
2026-03-17T22:06:12Z inference-api-xx tokenization.ERROR: "tokenize failed: unknown byte 0xff" request_id=abc-123
```
small numbers but curious if it's related to the encoder bump in this build.

nikhil: digging in — reproduction on canary: some legacy payloads with iso-8859 bytes hit tokenizer edge-case. i can push a microfix that normalizes input encoding before tokenization. will push an image tagged canary-fix-439 and re-run smoke if safe.

maria: thanks. please post the image tag and smoke result here. if errors >0.5% we roll back.

deploy-bot: Canary update: weight increased 10% -> 20% by nikhil at 2026-03-17T22:15:30Z (reason: hotfix push for tokenizer normalization).

harper: hotfix deployed (image: canary-fix-439). re-running the smoke script now.

qa-bot: smoke run finished — 200 requests: 200 OK, median latency 80ms, p95 145ms, 5xx 0.0%, tokenization errors 0/200.

maria: excellent. i'll let bake finish and promote to a full rollout in 10m if no additional noise. if anyone sees anything odd (errors, sudden latency, cache thrash), call it out here and we can pause rollout or rollback. thanks all :tada:

josh: +1, will watch dashboards and call if anything surfaces.

sre-ops: continuing 15m watch on autoscale edges, will report if scaling jitter recurs.

maria: closing this check-in — moving to watch channel after bake window. final note: recorded the rollback flag and reason in the deploy ticket #DL-4382.
